fullPassage: Empathy is frequently listed as one of the most desired skills in an employer or employee, although without specifying exactly what is meant by empathy. Some businesses stress cognitive empathy, emphasizing the need for leaders to understand the perspective of employees and customers when negotiating deals and making decisions. Others stress affective empathy and empathic concern, emphasizing the ability of leaders to gain trust from employees and customers by treating them with real concern and compassion. When some consultants argue that successful companies foster empathy, what that translates to is that companies should conduct good market research. In other words, an "empathic" company understands the needs and wants of its customers and seeks to fulfill those needs and wants. When some people speak of design with empathy, what that translates to is that companies should take into account the specific needs of different populations — the blind, the deaf, the elderly, non-English speakers, the color-blind, and so on — when designing products.

det.tip: 본문의 핵심: 공감이라는 하나의 개념이 비즈니스에서 여러 방식으로 구체화된다.

ch: 공감은 비즈니스 맥락에서 다양하게 해석되며, 구체적 실천으로 이어진다.
리더의 공감 능력은 타고나는 것이므로 훈련이 불가능하다.
공감적 디자인은 장애인만을 대상으로 하는 특수한 접근이다.
시장 조사는 고객의 감정을 이해하는 것과 무관한 활동이다.

questions.passage: Empathy is frequently listed as one of the most desired skills in an employer or employee, although without specifying exactly <u>what</u> is meant by empathy. Some businesses stress cognitive empathy, emphasizing the need for leaders to understand the perspective of employees and customers when negotiating deals and making decisions. Others stress affective empathy and empathic concern, emphasizing the ability of leaders to gain trust from employees and customers by treating them with real concern and compassion. When some consultants argue that successful companies foster empathy, what that translates to is that companies should conduct good market research. In other words, an "empathic" company understands the needs and wants of its customers and seeks to fulfill those needs and wants. When some people speak of design with empathy, what that translates to is that companies should take into account the specific needs of different populations — the blind, the deaf, the elderly, non-English speakers, the color-blind, and so on — when designing products.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>what that translates to</u>이(가) 다음 글에서 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: what that translates to = 그것이 실질적으로 의미하는 바. 추상적 개념(공감)이 구체적 실천으로 해석되는 맥락.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 언어 번역이 아니라 의미 해석의 맥락
❌ ② 과학적 증명 언급 없음
✅ ③ '그것이 실질적으로 의미하는 바' — translate to는 여기서 '~로 해석되다/~을 의미하다'라는 함축 ←정답
❌ ④ 역사적 변화 언급 없음
det.tip: translate to: 직역 '번역하다'가 아닌, '~을 의미하다/~로 해석되다'라는 비유적 의미.
